description:
Minjeong is sick and tired of living with her childhood trauma. Being a daughter of a murderer… It’s the memory she wishes to erase. She abandons her name, Minjeong Kim and starts a new life as Seon-Yong Do. However, the victim who had the whole family killed by Seon-Young’s father attacks her! When Seon-Young regains her consciousness, she finds herself at a hospital in 1995, the very day her father committed the first murder!   
(From KENAZ's website)
